name: 事件三域
observations: session/*(持久事实,追加日志) / agent/*(活跃Agent实时事件) / 能力事件(fs/* tools/* telemetry/*)
waterfall事件必须调next()委托; agent/turn-stopping 是serial事件无next()

name: 轮次流程
observations: turn/start -> claim输入 -> agent/pre-step -> step -> agent/request -> prepareCall -> llm/stream -> tool/call* -> step/end -> turn/end
pre-step可改写或拒绝输入; 首次领取被拒绝则关闭空轮次

deriveMessages() 从日志投影模型历史; JSONL v0/v1 + zstd, generation路径永不改名
